[1] This is a list of winners of the Academy Award for Performance by an Actress in a Supporting Role, presented annually by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS) to an actress who has delivered an outstanding performance while working within the film industry.
[2] The Blue Dragon Film Awards () is an annual awards ceremony that is presented by Sports Chosun (a sister brand of Chosun Ilbo) for excellence in film in South Korea.
[3] The Empire Award for Best Supporting Actress is an Empire Award presented annually by the British film magazine "Empire" to honor an actress who has delivered an outstanding performance in a supporting role while working within the film industry.
[4] Jo Eun-sook (born August 7, 1970) is a South Korean actress.
